marquee: Join our Instagram Channel to get early access to the SF in fall!
introTitle: What is MM College Ambassador Program?
intro: Master real-world marketing and build a standout portfolio, all while still in school! The My Monthly Ambassador Program gives you hands-on experience executing brand collaborations and content creation, including running sponsored campus events. By the end of the program, you'll have earned proof of your creative impact and a career-ready resume.
eligibilityTitle: You're PERFECT for the Program if you are ...
eligibility: Authentic, Empathetic, open-minded, and passionate about women’s health
Active on social media, with 1,500+ engaged followers across your primary platforms
Already following My Monthly and interested in staying connected with the brand
Bonus points if you’re an actual user of My Monthly!

learning.title: Day-in-the-Life & Vlogs
learning.body: Show authentic moments of how you use the app to manage your schedule, cycle, or relationship routines alongside campus life.

learning.title: Educational & “Spokesperson” Clips
learning.body: Casual, talk-to-camera videos talking about women's/menstrual health, breaking down key features of the app, and answering common questions from your followers.

learning.title: Memes, Trends & Short-Form Video
learning.body: Produce high-energy TikToks and Instagram Reels translating period humor, relatable couple dynamics, or student life using our brand assets.

learning.title: Event & Activation Coverage
learning.body: Recaps, behind-the-scenes preparation, and live coverage of on-campus pop-ups, speed dating nights, or club partnerships.

learningEnd: By the end of the program, you’ll have built a standout portfolio with real-world experience!

perks.title: Brand Exposure
perks.body: We'll feature you on our Instagram feed, through blog interviews, and in our creator spotlight series.

perks.title: Exclusive Merch & Care Drops
perks.body: We'll keep you stocked with fresh merch and exclusive gear.

perks.title: VIP Access
perks.body: Get tickets to local events and receive unreleased product drops.
